title: Review: retry failed chunk uploads
summary: The retry loop never ends for client errors, and the empty-chunk guard is gone. The new `HttpError` in client.ts:7-14 is a good base for the fix.

findings.title: Client errors (4xx) are retried forever
findings.symptom: An upload the server rejects, for example after the session expires, never finishes; the progress bar freezes and later files never upload.
findings.detail: The catch block only rethrows when the status is 5xx and the attempts are used up. A 4xx, or a network error that is not an `HttpError`, never matches, so `while (true)` spins forever. `UploadQueue.drain` awaits it at queue.ts:14, so the whole queue stalls.
findings.fix: Rethrow at once for errors that cannot succeed on retry (4xx, non-HttpError), and stop after `maxAttempts` for every other error.

findings.title: Empty-chunk guard was removed
findings.symptom: Uploading an empty file sends a request with no body; the server answers 400, which then loops forever (B1).
findings.detail: The base version rejected `chunk.size === 0` before sending. The change dropped the check without replacing it.
findings.fix: Restore the guard at the top of `uploadChunk`, before the retry loop.

findings.title: progressLabel shows NaN% for empty uploads
findings.detail: `done / total` is `0 / 0` when `total` is 0, and `Math.round(NaN)` stays NaN.

findings.title: No tests for the retry behavior
findings.symptom: Regressions in retry handling, like B1, ship unnoticed.
findings.detail: The change adds backoff and retry branches but no test file. Nothing covers success after a retry, a 4xx, or running out of attempts.
findings.fix: Add `src/upload/retry.test.ts` with a fake `sendChunk` and fake timers for those three paths.

findings.title: Backoff grows linearly
findings.detail: `backoffMs * attempt` waits 250, 500, 750 ms. Exponential backoff with jitter spreads retries better when many clients fail at once.

findings.title: `while (true)` hides the attempt limit
findings.detail: A `for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= options.maxAttempts; attempt++)` loop makes the limit visible and drops the manual counter at retry.ts:11.
